description_en: Obtain the Device ID based on the device MAC or SN
name: GetDeviceIdByIdentity

parameters.help_en: The value corresponding to the encoding type. Enter the Project ID of the project to which this product belongs. You can view it in the Tmall Genie AI platform console.
parameters.help_zh: 编码类型对应的值，此处填写该产品所在项目的Project ID。请在天猫精灵AI平台的控制台中查看
parameters.name: encode_key

parameters.help_zh: 设备认证类型，填写**MAC**或者**SN**或者**CTEI**
parameters.name: identity_type

parameters.help_en: Authentication identifier. Enter the MAC address or the SN value.
parameters.help_zh: 认证标识，填写MAC地址或者SN的值
parameters.name: identity_id

parameters.help_en: The unique product identifier ProductKey, which is a globally unique identity issued by the platform when the product is created in the Tmall Genie AI platform. This parameter is optional when IdentityType is **CTEI**.
parameters.help_zh: 产品唯一标志符productKey，在天猫精灵AI平台中创建产品时，平台颁发的全局唯一标识。当IdentityType为**CTEI**时可不传
parameters.name: product_key
